digest.headline: Platform and AI tooling, week 41
digest.intro: Three releases worth a look this week.

items.title: Cobbett SSO adds device trust
items.summary: Cobbett SSO adds device trust checks to sign-in. Admins can require passkeys for chosen groups.

items.title: Harrowgate Auth adds passkey login
items.summary: Harrowgate Auth adds passkey login for hosted sign-in pages. Existing password accounts can add a passkey from the profile page.
items.whyItMatters: Users can sign in without typing a password.

items.title: Ormsby Vector adds filtered hybrid search
items.summary: Ormsby Vector adds filtered hybrid search that combines keyword and vector scores. Filters run before scoring, so results stay fast on large collections.
items.whyItMatters: Search over large collections stays responsive.

sources.title: Cobbett SSO adds device trust
sources.summary: Cobbett SSO adds device trust checks to sign-in. A device must report a recent patch level before it gets a session. Reports are kept for audit.

sources.title: Harrowgate Auth adds passkey login
sources.summary: Harrowgate Auth adds passkey login for hosted sign-in pages. Existing password accounts can add a passkey from the profile page. Admins can require passkeys for chosen groups.

sources.title: Ormsby Vector adds filtered hybrid search
sources.summary: Ormsby Vector adds filtered hybrid search that combines keyword and vector scores. Filters run before scoring, so results stay fast on large collections. Result pages can be fetched with a stable cursor.
